items.summary: Reviewer disposition: reject the noveltyguns.com implementation proposal and all new production or high-priority queue work. The snapshot lacks site-specific repository, active-work, telemetry, release, and security evidence; no measurable production outcome is supportable. Preserve the gate. CTO and principal-engineer must document release and admission evidence by 2026-10-03T17:00Z; unresolved blockers escalate to the owner. One bounded public inspection is retained to address the specific evidence gap without changing telemetry, configuration, credentials, spending, schedules, or production.
